headline: Voters in 2 North Dakota counties reject property tax increases
summary: Voters in Divide and Traill counties rejected property tax increase measures, indicating a reluctance to raise taxes amidst economic concerns.

headline: New Mexico immigrant groups urge Legislature to crack down on local police ‘handoffs’ to ICE agents
summary: Immigrant advocates in New Mexico revealed evidence of local law enforcement assisting federal immigration agents in detentions, undermining state laws; two legislators plan to introduce a bill in 2027 to curb this practice.

headline: Effort to recall Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry fails
summary: The effort to recall Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry failed due to insufficient signatures, with organizers citing mismanagement and lack of transparency. The failed recall attempt did not lead to protests or civil unrest.

headline: New outbreak of mpox in Anchorage prompts advisory from state health officials
summary: Alaska is experiencing an outbreak of mpox, with four new cases in Anchorage, the highest number since 2022. Unlike previous cases, these patients had no recent out-of-state travel, suggesting local transmission. State health officials are encouraging at-risk individuals to get vaccinated with JYNNEOS, which guards against both mpox clades and smallpox. Two cases of borealpox, a rarer pox disease, have also been diagnosed this year.

headline: Vermont stores feel ripple effect of strike at grocery distributor
summary: Strike by New England Teamsters at Associated Grocers over pension plan disruption affecting Vermont grocery stores, with some seeing reduced stock and delayed deliveries.

headline: Pollsters, data centers and fraud risk: CT politics news
summary: "Pollster Quinnipiac's prediction of a 20-point lead for Governor Ned Lamont was validated with his 19.1-point victory over Ryan Fazio. Lamont's 59.55% to 40.44% win was his best since M. Jodi Rell's 63% in 2006."

headline: Arkansas governor proposes spending hikes for Medicaid, SNAP, school vouchers in $7B budget
summary: Arkansas Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders proposed a $7 billion budget for FY 2028, including a $449 million surplus. The budget allocates funds for school vouchers, early childhood education, Medicaid, and SNAP. It also includes a fifth round of income tax cuts. Democrats have criticized the budget for not addressing needs adequately and raising concerns about the school voucher program's growing cost.
